hashEncoding: sha256(JSON.stringify(value)); preserves key/array order and every recording field

policy.d6: Same runner only; P95 +10%, objective-round P99 / command max +25%, elapsed +10%, minimum 1ms. Any metric crossing in >=2 of 3 comparable rounds means regression. Full routes with different event/objective-block counts are report-only; the identical input prefix decides. Absolute times report only.
policy.correctness: hard: complete replay, zero OOS, exact semantic/RNG/domain/final state hashes
policy.work: hard: calls <= calibrated maximum; objective block count exact

relativeWarning.rule: dedicated runner: at least 2 of 3; currently report only

source.planner: omniscient BFS; bounded deterministic recovery v1; no world edits

provenance.authorization: Maintainer 2026-10-17: investigate C3 tails then freeze with limitations; close C4 from downloaded split artifacts. No new cloud timing.
provenance.calibration: All original B full rounds 1/2/3, unchanged observer/freezer; split machines allowed only between cases. No sample removal or local timing substitution.
limitations: No complete independent fourth cloud B pair; calibration checks reuse three original runs.
Absolute milliseconds are runner-specific report-only; no cross-shard or cross-run timing comparison.
Browser/mobile, D22+, maximum residents, active station/reforge/craft and part-drop loads are not established by this natural route.
Historical incomplete is expected pending-baseline gating, not a tool defect; timing passes after C3 acceptance, offline adoption is separate from automatic held-out verification.
